title: StatsCard hover glow uses a valid CSS color value, not a raw Chakra token string
description: src/components/common/StatsCard.jsx's icon-container _groupHover sets boxShadow to the literal string '0 8px 20px ' + colorName + '.700' (e.g. '0 8px 20px blue.700'). 'blue.700' is a Chakra theme token name, not a CSS color — browsers discard the entire boxShadow declaration as invalid, so the intended hover glow never renders. This case guards against this exact bug re-appearing after a fix (e.g. resolving the token to its rgba() value via the theme, matching the accent-glow rgba pattern documented in §4).
steps: Hover a stats card built with StatsCard.jsx (e.g., /audit-assurance/programme) with devtools computed-styles panel open on the icon container
Inspect the computed box-shadow value during hover
expectedResult: The computed box-shadow is a valid CSS shadow (e.g. an rgba() glow matching the card's accent color) and a visible glow renders around the icon container on hover. It must not be, or resolve to, the invalid literal string '0 8px 20px <colorName>.700'.

title: Risk Center overview icon containers stay theme-aware after any future edit to page.jsx
description: Regression guard for src/app/(private)/risk-center/page.jsx, which hardcodes bg='red.900'/borderColor='red.700' (Top Active Risks icon, ~line 490), bg='purple.900'/borderColor='purple.700' (live-pulse indicator, ~line 993), bg='blue.900'/borderColor='blue.700' (~line 1311), and bg='orange.900'/borderColor='orange.700' (~line 1356), all with no useColorModeValue wrapper. Once fixed, this case must catch any regression back to hardcoded dark-only values.
steps: Set color mode to Light and open /risk-center
Visually inspect the four icon containers listed in the description (Top Active Risks header icon, the pulsing live indicator, and the two icon containers further down the page)
expectedResult: All four icon containers render a light, theme-appropriate tint (colorName.50 background / colorName.200 border) in light mode and only switch to the darker colorName.900/800 shades in dark mode. None should appear as a near-black chip while in light mode.

title: Vendor Management toasts remain anchored bottom-right after future edits to VendorProfileDrawer.jsx
description: Regression guard for src/components/vendor-management/VendorProfileDrawer.jsx, which currently issues toast() calls with position:'top-right' on the file-open-failure, download-failure, and download-warning paths (~lines 1202, 1222, 1990) — contradicting the platform-wide bottom-right rule at §6.12.
steps: In Vendor Management, open a vendor profile and trigger the file-open or file-download error path (e.g., attempt to open a file with a revoked/broken link)
Observe the resulting toast's screen position
expectedResult: The error/warning toast anchors bottom-right, matching every other toast on the platform. It must not appear top-right.

title: StatsCard padding, icon size, and KPI value font size do not silently drift further from the agreed baseline
description: Regression guard tracking the sizing gap between src/components/common/StatsCard.jsx (px=3/py=2 outer padding, p=1/boxSize=3 icon container, fontSize='md' stat value) and the canonical §6.1 spec (px=4/py=3, p=1.5/boxSize=3.5, fontSize='2xl'). Whether the team standardizes on the compact variant or reconciles StatsCard.jsx to the letter of the spec, this case exists to catch any further, unintentional drift in either direction.
steps: Measure the rendered outer padding, icon container padding/size, and KPI value font-size of a StatsCard instance via devtools box model
Compare against the previously recorded baseline values (px=3/py=2, p=1/boxSize=3, fontSize='md')
expectedResult: The measured values match the currently agreed baseline exactly (or, once reconciled with the spec, match §6.1's px=4/py=3/boxSize=3.5/fontSize=2xl values) — any further deviation from whichever baseline is agreed indicates an unreviewed styling change.

title: Evidence Management search input remains a themed Chakra Input, not a reintroduced raw HTML input
description: Regression guard for src/components/evidence-management/EvidenceFilters.jsx's search field, hand-built from Box as='input' with a hardcoded blue.400 focus color and a non-token search icon color instead of Chakra's InputGroup/Input/InputLeftElement pattern (§6.5). Guards against the same anti-pattern being reintroduced elsewhere or left unfixed here.
steps: Inspect the Evidence Management search input's rendered element type and focus-state styling in devtools
Compare its focus ring color against the brand.500/brand.300 token used by standard Chakra Input fields elsewhere on the platform
expectedResult: The search input is (or has been migrated to) a standard Chakra Input/InputGroup component whose focus ring and icon color derive from useColorModeValue-wrapped brand/gray tokens, matching every other input field on the platform.
